name: Mono County, CA
findings: Mono County has 14 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (71%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mono County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Mono County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
